facts.fact: Sudani's deputy director general says the company restored its core data centre, now fully operational and serving government bodies, private institutions and citizens; the article gives no date of restoration, so as_of is the article date.

Sudani's deputy director general says the company lost its Tier-4 data centre that hosted state government and institutions, along with other assets, in damage exceeding USD 70 million; no date of loss is given, so as_of is the article date.
